items.title: Manuel Mello Interview, 1959-08-03
items.q: I said, Lyle. He looked at me. I said, Lyle. It's all right. So, we had Joe Castro and Joe Castro and Little Wire Face, they're going out to us... We started off, man. We tore them up going to the where the old throw was laid out.

ctx.x: Colored that was with a beating heart with a colored folks. They used to have a dance every Saturday night. L-I-V-A had to get all that stuff because L-I-V-A had to have to hit a piece twice or three times before I could play it. But then L-I-V-A had to hit that thing once. Lance, Lance, he'd hit that thing once. Boy, he might make one or two humbugs on it, but he ain't gonna make too many humbugs. He had a quick ear and a good ear. I mean a real good ear. Did you tell me one time that he used to go around to…
Did Lyle's work with many bands that you didn't work with? Well,
